subject.title: feat(ui): group native session catalog rows by project in the sidebar

question: Should native session catalogs switch existing users to project grouping by default, with one global persisted toggle for both Codex and Claude catalogs?
rationale: The patch introduces a new user-facing default and persisted setting; tests can validate mechanics, but maintainers must choose the intended upgrade behavior.

options.title: Group by default
options.body: Approve the proposed default after the Windows-root correction and live native-catalog proof, retaining the toggle for users who prefer the old layout.

options.title: Keep flat by default
options.body: Ship grouping as an opt-in persisted preference so upgrades preserve the existing sidebar presentation.

recommendation.title: Group by default
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed default after the Windows-root correction and live native-catalog proof, retaining the toggle for users who prefer the old layout.
